title: Low-Cal Tofu 'Bacon' Cobb Salad
subtitle: with Charred Corn and Feta
description: What's better than bacon? Tofu with all the crispiness and smokiness of bacon! This clever vegetarian twist is the star player in our scrumptious cobb salad.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a small saucepan of water to the boil for the eggs (see Kitchen 101). Preheat the grill to high. Line an oven tray with foil. Discard the husk and silks from the corn, then slice the kernels from the cob. Cut the tomato into wedges.

Grill tofu: Put the tofu flat on a board, put your hand on top and halve each piece horizontally. Put the tofu, cut side up, on the lined tray. Scatter over half the barbecue seasoning, then drizzle with 1 tsp olive oil and 2 tsp honey. Grill, turning halfway, for 8 mins or until the tofu is charred.
Boil eggs: Meanwhile, cook 2 eggs in the pan of boiling water for 6 mins for soft-boiled or 8 mins for hard-boiled. Drain, then cool in cold water.

Char corn: While the eggs are cooking, heat a medium frypan over high heat. Cook the corn and remaining barbecue seasoning, stirring, for 3-4 mins until the corn is charred. Remove the pan from the heat.

Serve up: Peel and quarter the eggs. Put 1 tbs olive oil and 2 tsp red wine vinegar in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine. Divide the salad leaves, tomato, corn, tofu 'bacon' and eggs among bowls. Crumble over the feta, drizzle with the dressing and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: If you have the time, remove your eggs from the fridge and bring to room temperature before cooking – it makes them less likely to crack during cooking and easier to peel.
